name: Akishika Junmai
description:
Pure & Earthy. Robust, deeply expressive, with natural umami and vibrant acidity. Best with hearty dishes.

Akishika's Junmai sake is robust and deeply expressive, showcasing the natural umami of the rice. Brewed with low-polished rice and traditional methods, it has a bold structure with pronounced acidity, giving it excellent food-pairing versatility. Its full-bodied profile reflects the brewery's farm-based philosophy and the terroir of Nose Town.

name: Akishika Junmai Daiginjo
description:
Refined & Aromatic. Elegant fragrance, silky mouthfeel, layered umami. Best with delicate Japanese cuisine.

Akishika's Junmai Daiginjo is a premium expression of their craft, using highly polished rice and careful temperature control during fermentation. Despite its refined character and floral, melon-like aromas, it retains the complexity and natural essence of the rice.

name: Aged / Limited Edition Sake
description: Special aged or limited edition sake from Akishika. Each season brings a different expression—please ask staff for today's selection and tasting notes.

name: Akishika Tasting Set
description: Tasting set of 3 Akishika sakes. Experience the full range of Akishika's sake craftsmanship — from crisp junmai to elegant daiginjo and aged editions.

name: Akishika Highball
description: Refreshing highball crafted with Akishika sake and soda. Available in three variations: classic Akishika, house-made syrup, or bright lemon.

name: Apple Cocktail
description: A delicate cocktail featuring local Toyono apple juice blended with Akishika sake. Sweet, fragrant, and beautifully balanced — a gentle introduction to Japanese sake culture.

name: Apple Hot Sake
description: Warm Akishika sake infused with the natural sweetness of local apple juice. A comforting, aromatic drink perfect for cooler evenings. The warmth gently opens up the sake's floral notes.
